text: Gardening is an enjoyable and rewarding hobby that brings beauty and tranquility to any home. One of the most important steps in gardening is creating a healthy soil foundation through compost. Compost enriches the soil with essential nutrients and organic matter, promoting the growth of strong and vibrant plants. As gardeners continue to add compost to their soil, it becomes richer and more vibrant, supporting a bountiful harvest. Once the compost is established, gardeners can then layer in a convenient mulch for further soil enhancement. Mulch acts as a protective layer, retaining moisture, regulating soil temperature, and suppressing weeds, while also enriching the soil as it breaks down. Together, compost and mulch form a sustainable gardening system that ensures a lush and productive garden year after year.
